description: Closed category vocabulary aligned with the nuScenes detection class set. The parser applies this table deterministically before schema validation; unmapped terms are recorded in ParseResult.unmapped_terms and reported as semantic_range_failure. Generic terms such as 'vehicle' or 'object' are intentionally unmapped because mapping them would be a semantic guess, which the Stage 03 no-silent-repair rule forbids.
